newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: US lends Ivory Coast $5 mln to improve rice output.
newsitem.headline: US lends Ivory Coast $5 mln to improve rice output.

text.p: The United States on Wednesday signed an agreement under which it will lend Ivory Coast $5 million which will ultimately be used to develop Ivorian rice production.
The Ivory Coast government will use the funds to buy U.S. rice, which will then be sold to Ivorian factories to be processed.
The government will use the proceeds of the sale to fund small-scale rice developments in villages around the country.
At a signing ceremony, Lannon Walker, the U.S. ambassador to Ivory Coast, congratulated the government on its "farsightedness" in taking such an initiative.
He said the 30-year loan would carry an interest rate of two percent during a five-year grace period, and three percent thereafter.
Ivory Coast Agriculture Minister Lambert Kouassi Konan said that the U.S. loan would go some way to helping Ivory Coast boost rice output in order to satisfy domestic needs.
